description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of Archaeomancer.
The Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking the nontoken Archaeomancer.
The nontoken Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
